title: Closest Normal Matrix Found Again Using Riemannian Optimization
summary: We propose an approach based on Riemannian optimization to compute a nearest normal matrix to a given one. The problem can be formulated as the minimization of a smooth function either on the manifold $U(n)$ of unitary matrices of size n or on the flag manifold $U (n)/U (1)^n$.
